lifecycle: mount(host) writes its own reader markup, caches local nodes and registers owned listeners
render(reason = 'state', event = app.player.snapshot()) updates stable reader sections only at meaningful canonical/selection changes
onPlayer(event) updates meaningful state without replacing the whole reader or stealing focus/scroll
unmount() explicitly removes listeners and presentation-owned resources; parent clears host
compactPresenter.sharedHeader: Parent owns #studio, the View buttons, ScenarioPicker and workspace picker, theme button, shared toast/popups, mode preference and app-level lifecycle. Compact mount receives only the active presentation host. Never duplicate shared header IDs, search pickers or live regions.
compactPresenter.evidenceRendering: Use app.renderCompactEvidence() for the existing PAM, decision, Windows, lifetime, protocol-history, lesson-input and learning-reference renderers. Parent makes these legitimate active-surface renderers without Full geometry. Compact may add semantics/disclosures around their stable contract markup, not duplicate protocol logic.
compactPresenter.heldState: app.heldView remains the one shared state object. compiled(), snapshot(event), buildTrace(artifactId), select(selection), inspectionHtml(snapshot) are available without Full DOM/geometry/observers. selection, actorId, expanded, initial and selected are shared. inspectionHtml uses the shared permission-scoped inspector projector, including detached history. Do not invoke old trace() or configureGeometry()/render() from Compact.
compactPresenter.logicalActors: app.studyActor(id) returns the exact logical actor, without Full folding.
compactPresenter.queue: app.studyQueue() returns {rows,kind,label,position,initial,atEnd,empty,playback,cursor}. rows are the actual active journey/field/exact-object/connection queue; position is an integer active-queue row. Initial cursor may be -1; no-match traces stay empty.
compactPresenter.events: Compact owns its lesson-input, playback, disclosure, queue, held-inspection, field-history and exact-copy interactions. Disclosures/search/history pause only if playing; closing never resumes. Parent owns common search, View, theme, routing and popup interactions. Do not bind Full graph or window handlers.
compactPresenter.naming: Compact reader classes use compact-study/compact-* selectors and cannot reuse Full dock-geometry compact names. New module-private helpers use compact prefixes; parent explicitly isolates the new module in the concatenated build.

verification.newCanonicalFields: Never remove/normalize protocol fields to achieve parity, including PAM evaluation/results, authority generation, permission/knowledge, clocks/expiry and custody. Stable serialization must preserve meaningful undefined and typed data if encountered.
verification.runnerRules: Producers derive default checkout from import.meta.url, bind exact source/HTML/producer/helper/manifest inputs before and after, keep attempted/pass/fail/unperformed distinct, preserve all failed attempts, and never claim native/device/AT acceptance from DOM or emulation.

workRules: Read the actual complete supplied plan for your slice.
No build, lint, test, formatter, install or browser launch during delegated implementation.

The catalog owner may execute phase-0 registry enumeration only, against the immutable accepted control; no comparisons or acceptance collection until the parent integrates and freezes candidate inputs.
Use surgical edits for existing files and write for new files. ASCII hyphens only in authored project text; immutable original inputs stay exact.
No commit, push, deployment, release or waiver.
No stubs, fake fallbacks, catch-and-ignore failures, weakened tests or raised timeouts.
